policy: Auxiliary leads do not satisfy owner-edition acceptance for every historical row. Never silently promote from broad or historical commentary; exact site/day/time/edition and current recurrence are independent gates.

leads.observation: Messes.info lists Notre Dame des Victoires Angers Sunday 25 October 2026 10:30 Latin sung Mass according to Missal of St John XXIII and Monday 26 October 2026 18:30 as Missal of St John XXIII. Its Sunday 09:00 and Saturday 18:30 celebrations explicitly use current Missal. Distinguish and do not certify eight historical 1962 slots from this partial dated alternative.

Third-party parish transcription mentions special feasts of the 1962 calendar and the Gregorian Mass programme, but does not establish that the live current owner page explicitly certifies all six CL11 weekday hours. Separate third-party source lists Monday/Friday 08:00 while frozen rows say 08:30, so live recurrence also must be reconfirmed.

Official historical parish music archive explicitly distinguishes a weekly solemn 1962 Extraordinary Form and a 2002 Latin Mass, showing why 'Latin' alone is ambiguous. Archive is dated 2013 and does not demonstrate the frozen 2026 Sun 10:00 and Tue/Wed/Fri 12:10 slots use the 1962 edition unconditionally. Thursday school-term ordinary form is a known exception.
